name: whoami
description: Return the authenticated user's id, email, role (user or admin), and admin status.

name: search_users
description: Search registered accounts by email or display name (admin only). Returns up to 50 accounts with id, email, display_name, role and created_at. Empty query lists accounts; use offset increments of 50 to paginate. Civic people records are separate from login accounts.

name: promote_user_to_admin
description: Promote an existing registered user to admin (admin only). Grants content editing, private-content access and permission to promote other users immediately. Resolve the exact account with search_users and act only on an explicit request to promote that person. Cannot promote yourself, create an account or demote an admin. Repeating a promotion of another existing admin is harmless.

name: search_organizations
description: Full-text search of community organizations.

name: search_maps
description: Full-text search of maps.

name: search_events
description: Search calendar events. Regular users see public listings; only admins can discover unlisted and private events.

name: search_people
description: Full-text search of people (officials, candidates).

name: search_elections
description: Full-text search of elections.

name: list_calendars
description: List calendars the caller can see, optionally for one organization.

name: get_map
description: Fetch one map with visible layers and their effective styles.

name: get_event
description: Fetch one event (with calendar + organization) by id.

name: get_person
description: Fetch one person (with affiliations) by id.

name: get_election
description: Fetch one election (with contests and key dates) by id.

name: create_organization
description: Create an organization (admin only).

name: update_organization
description: Update an organization (admin only).

name: delete_organization
description: Delete an organization (admin only).

name: create_calendar
description: Create a calendar (admin only).

name: update_calendar
description: Update a calendar (admin only).

name: delete_calendar
description: Delete a calendar (admin only).

name: create_event
description: Create a calendar event (admin only).

name: update_event
description: Update a calendar event (admin only).

name: delete_event
description: Delete a calendar event (admin only).

name: create_person
description: Create a person (admin only).

name: update_person
description: Update a person (admin only).

name: delete_person
description: Delete a person (admin only).

name: create_election
description: Create an election (admin only).

name: update_election
description: Update an election (admin only).

name: delete_election
description: Delete an election (admin only).

name: search_site
description: Search or browse all civic content, including related names, roles and stored-layer properties. Visibility follows your account.

name: search_calendars
description: Search or browse calendars with pagination. Use the returned id with get_calendar.

name: search_layers
description: Search or browse layers with pagination. Use the returned id with get_layer.

name: search_articles
description: Search or browse articles with pagination. Use the returned id with get_article.

name: search_contests
description: Search or browse contests with pagination. Use the returned id with get_contest.

name: search_ballot_questions
description: Search or browse ballot questions with pagination. Use the returned id with get_ballot_question.

name: get_organization
description: Get one organization by id. Article association sets are returned only to admins.

name: get_calendar
description: Get one calendar by id. Article association sets are returned only to admins.

name: get_layer
description: Get one layer by id. Article association sets are returned only to admins.

name: get_article
description: Get one article by id. Article association sets are returned only to admins.

name: get_contest
description: Get one contest by id. Article association sets are returned only to admins.

name: get_ballot_question
description: Get one ballot question by id. Article association sets are returned only to admins.

name: get_map_layers
description: Get visible layers in stacking order, including effective per-map styles.

name: get_layer_geojson
description: Get stored layer geometry. Non-admin callers must provide a visible map containing this layer.

name: get_person_articles
description: Get a person’s permitted article reading list, with publication dates and relationship labels.

name: get_organization_articles
description: Get an organization’s permitted article reading list.

name: get_person_candidacies
description: Get a person’s visible current and past election candidacies.

name: list_person_organizations
description: Get organization affiliations through the person visibility gate.

name: list_contests
description: List an election’s contests through its visibility gate.

name: list_ballot_questions
description: List an election’s ballot questions through its visibility gate.

name: list_contest_candidates
description: List the candidates of a visible contest, including party, status and certified write-in flag.

name: get_contest_candidate
description: Get one person’s candidacy through the contest/election visibility gate.

name: create_map
description: Create a map (admin only). Add reusable layers using create_map_layer.

name: update_map
description: Partially update a map (admin only). Layer links are managed separately.

name: delete_map
description: Delete a map and its layer links, preserving reusable layers (admin only).

name: create_layer
description: Create a remote GeoJSON URL layer (admin only). Use save_postgis_layer for stored geometry.

name: update_layer
description: Partially update layer metadata (admin only). This does not replace stored geometry or change its source type.

name: delete_layer
description: Delete a reusable layer, its stored features and all map links (admin only).

name: save_postgis_layer
description: Create or update a stored PostGIS layer atomically (admin only). Creation requires name and a GeoJSON FeatureCollection. Use id to update; omitted metadata is preserved. Omit geojson on update to keep features; otherwise the entire dataset is replaced. Limit: 10 MB / 10,000 features.

name: create_map_layer
description: Create a map layer link (admin only).

name: update_map_layer
description: Update link fields without changing either endpoint (admin only).

name: delete_map_layer
description: Delete only this map layer link (admin only).

name: list_map_layer_links
description: Get editable positions and style overrides for map-layer links (admin only).

name: create_contest
description: Create an office contest within an election (admin only).

name: update_contest
description: Partially update an election contest (admin only).

name: delete_contest
description: Delete a contest and its candidacy links, preserving people (admin only).

name: create_contest_candidate
description: Create a contest candidate link (admin only).

name: update_contest_candidate
description: Update link fields without changing either endpoint (admin only).

name: delete_contest_candidate
description: Delete only this contest candidate link (admin only).

name: create_ballot_question
description: Create a referendum/amendment/ballot question (admin only). Defaults to Yes/No choices.

name: update_ballot_question
description: Partially update a ballot question (admin only).

name: delete_ballot_question
description: Delete a ballot question (admin only).

name: create_person_organization
description: Create a person organization link (admin only).

name: update_person_organization
description: Update link fields without changing either endpoint (admin only).

name: delete_person_organization
description: Delete only this person organization link (admin only).

name: get_organization_relationships
description: List related organizations, with labels normalized for the requested profile and source URLs.

name: create_organization_relationship
description: Link two different organizations (admin only). relationship labels the related organization on the first profile; reverse_relationship labels the first on the related profile. One row appears on both profiles; reverse duplicate pairs are rejected.

name: update_organization_relationship
description: Update an organization relationship by id (admin only). Omitted fields are preserved.

name: delete_organization_relationship
description: Delete an organization relationship from both profiles, preserving both organizations (admin only).

name: create_article
description: Create an article and optional person/organization links atomically (admin only). Omit unknown dates; never infer publication dates from fetched dates.

name: update_article
description: Partially update an article atomically (admin only). Omitted fields and association sets are preserved; null clears a date and [] clears that link set.

name: delete_article
description: Delete an article and its association links, preserving people/organizations (admin only).

name: create_article_person
description: Create a article person link (admin only).

name: update_article_person
description: Update link fields without changing either endpoint (admin only).

name: delete_article_person
description: Delete only this article person link (admin only).

name: create_article_organization
description: Create a article organization link (admin only).

name: update_article_organization
description: Update link fields without changing either endpoint (admin only).

name: delete_article_organization
description: Delete only this article organization link (admin only).

name: list_article_people
description: List editable article association links (admin only). Profile reading lists remain available to other users.

name: list_article_organizations
description: List editable article association links (admin only). Profile reading lists remain available to other users.

name: search_layer_features
description: Search or browse stored feature properties with pagination. IDs are bigint strings. Non-admins must supply a visible map containing the layer.

name: get_layer_feature
description: Get one stored feature by its internal bigint-string id. Non-admins must provide a visible containing map.

name: create_layer_feature
description: Create a stored-layer feature atomically (admin only). Geometry must be WGS84 longitude/latitude. Position defaults to the next available position.

name: update_layer_feature
description: Partially update a stored feature without replacing the dataset (admin only). null clears the source feature_id; internal id remains unchanged.

name: delete_layer_feature
description: Delete one stored feature (admin only).

name: get_my_profile
description: Get your own account profile.

name: update_my_profile
description: Update your own display name. This does not grant admin access or edit another user.

name: list_images
description: Browse/search public organization logos or person images, with pagination.

name: get_image_url
description: Get the public URL for an organization logo or person image.

name: upload_image
description: Upload a user-supplied PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG image (admin only, max 2 MB). Base64 must omit any data-URL prefix. Set overwrite only when replacing an existing image; use the returned path in logo_path or image_path.

name: delete_image
description: Remove an organization logo or person image object (admin only). Update any record referencing its path separately.
